intro: An educational and IT hub of Central Europe with a large post-Soviet diaspora. Charles University accepts foreign students. Since 2022, visas for Russian citizens have been heavily restricted.
climate: Temperate continental: warm summers of +20-25°C and cold, snowy winters of -5°C. Grey, rainy autumns and springs.
mentality: A reserved, rational Central European culture. Respect for personal space, punctuality and the rule of law.
language_note: Czech is the official language; being Slavic, it is partly understandable to Russian speakers. English is used in IT and education.
visa_note: Since 2022, tourist visas are unavailable to Russian citizens. The realistic routes are employment (employee card / blue card), study and family reunification.
